_meta.description: Glossary v1 (EPIC-21): the canonical English UI words, their approved translations, one-line definitions, banned synonyms and permanent search aliases. The translator agent enforces it.

owner.decision: Q12 (glossary v1) and the approved status and money vocabulary

translatorSignOff.statement: Every German form was checked against the owner-approved glossary v1; terms marked shipped match the current German UI.

_meta.transition: Words under formerly and doNotUse may remain in existing strings until the EPIC-21 story that renames that label replaces them; every new or changed string uses the canon. Former names stay search aliases permanently and are never removed.

Home.definition: The start page: what needs you, this week, and how the build is doing.

doNotUse.context: as a page name; it stays a tab word

Task.definition: A piece of building work in an area, done by a company or by you, with dates, cost and the tasks it waits for.

Purchase.definition: Something you buy for the house rather than build, such as furniture, appliances or fixtures, with its delivery and cost.

Site diary.definition: The record of what happened on site, day by day, mostly told through photos.

Diary entry.definition: What happened on site on one day for one trade or delivery.

Photo.definition: A site photo tagged with an area and an orientation.

de.note: An (area × orientation) combination representing a specific viewpoint for photos in the photo browser. The term 'Blickpunkt' (viewpoint) naturally conveys the sense of a particular perspective from which photos are taken.

Spot.definition: One area plus one orientation, seen over time in its photos.

Orientation.definition: The household's own label for where a photo looks, such as a wall, the ceiling or the street side; "No orientation" is valid.

Caption.definition: The one text field of a photo; it replaces the separate caption and description.

Company.definition: A business you work with or buy from, with its trade, contact persons and phone.

Contact person.definition: A person at a company you can call or write to.

Offer.definition: A company's priced proposal, cost estimate or order confirmation; progress payments are made against it and it becomes the final invoice.

Invoice.definition: A bill to pay: split into cost lines on tasks and purchases, then paid, then submitted to the bank.

Area.definition: A part of the house: a building, a floor or a room; every task, purchase and photo sits in one.

Money.definition: The section for budget, offers, invoices and funding.

Milestone.definition: A date the build works towards, such as finishing a floor.

Cost line.definition: One priced line on a task or purchase: an estimate, or a line of an offer or invoice.

de.shortFormNote: product-owner-approved (#1917) short-form variant of 'Abschlagszahlung', permitted ONLY under a measured space constraint — do not use elsewhere. Origin: the report PDF's 'abzgl. Abschlag' inline label lives in a 75pt table column. 'Abschlagszahlung' alone already measures 72.85pt, so no qualifier of any length fits alongside it — not 'abzgl.', not 'ohne', not './.'. There is no third option: keeping the full term forces dropping the qualifier, which collapses this label into the separate constituted-deposit label '(Abschlagszahlung)' (#1923 AC2.1) — a different fact ('this row IS a deposit' vs. 'this amount is reduced because deposits were claimed separately'). A future compliance sweep must NOT revert this to 'Abschlagszahlung' without re-measuring the 75pt column budget first; doing so silently breaks the PDF (label wraps mid-bracket, #1959).

Progress payment.definition: A part payment against an offer or invoice.

Refund.definition: Money a company pays back, recorded against an offer or invoice.

Final payment.definition: The last payment that settles an invoice after its progress payments.

Funding source.definition: A loan, a credit line or your own funds.

Own funds.definition: The built-in funding source for money you pay yourselves.

Grant.definition: A programme that pays back a percentage of the eligible costs of specific tasks and purchases, up to a cap.

Draw-down request.definition: A bank report asking the lender to pay out against invoices.

Bank report.definition: The step-by-step report for the bank: a draw-down request, a budget overview or a proof of funds.

Trade.definition: A craft such as plumbing or drywall.

Cost category.definition: A classification list for cost lines, kept in Project setup.

Purchase category.definition: A classification list for purchases, kept in Project setup.

Category.definition: An entry of a classification list (see Cost category and Purchase category).

House.definition: The project's name, address and entry language; shown in the app and used as the sender of bank letters.

History.definition: The automatic record of changes to an object.

Checklist.definition: The small to-dos of a task.

Checklist item.definition: One small to-do on a task.

Note.definition: A short written comment: on a task, or a diary entry without a fixed type.

Who.definition: The company or household member doing a task (one of the two).

Dependency.definition: A link that makes one task wait for another task or a milestone.

Unassigned.definition: No value is set yet, for example no area or no company.

Draft.definition: A saved record that is not final yet.

Correspondent.definition: The sender or recipient of a Paperless document.

AI.definition: Artificial intelligence: the configured language model that suggests values.

AI assistance.definition: Features where the AI drafts or extracts values for you to check.

AI certainty.definition: How sure the AI is about a value it extracted.

Annotation.definition: A mark drawn on a photo: a shape, an arrow, freehand or a callout.

Callout.definition: A text bubble drawn on a photo.

Freehand.definition: A line drawn by hand on a photo.

Schedule.definition: The time view of tasks, purchases and milestones.

doNotUse.context: as a label; it stays a search alias

Calendar.definition: The month and week view of tasks, purchases and milestones.

Financing.definition: The Money view of funding sources, grants and bank reports.

Settings.definition: Settings only: project setup, account, users, backups and integrations.

Project setup.definition: The settings of the house: lists, categories, trades and photo orientations.

Account.definition: Your own login, name, language and theme.

Users.definition: The household members who can sign in, and their roles.

Backups.definition: Copies of the database you can create and restore.

Integrations.definition: Connections to other services such as Paperless, AI and calendar feeds.

Documents.definition: The Paperless documents linked to your records (only with Paperless).

Daily log.definition: A diary entry about a normal working day on site.

Site visit.definition: A diary entry recording a walk through the site, with its start and end time.

Delivery.definition: A diary entry recording what arrived on site and from whom.

Defect.definition: A diary entry about something built wrong or damaged, kept until it is fixed.

Late.definition: A task or purchase past its planned date, or a milestone projected after its target.

doNotUse.context: for tasks, purchases and milestones; it stays the invoice word

Early.definition: A milestone projected before its target date.

Waits for.definition: The tasks or milestones this one cannot start before.

Holds up.definition: Every unfinished task that moves if this one slips, milestone gates included.

Held up.definition: A task waiting for a late task.

Counts toward.definition: A task linked to a milestone it helps to reach.

Waiting for this milestone.definition: A task that cannot start before the milestone is reached.

Critical.definition: On the chain of tasks that sets the end date: if it slips, the end date moves.

Critical path.definition: The chain of tasks that sets the end date.

To pay.definition: An invoice or progress payment that is due and not paid yet.

doNotUse.context: as an invoice or progress-payment status

Paid.definition: Paid, but not yet included in a draw-down request; as a figure, the paid and submitted amounts together.

Submitted.definition: Paid or due, and included in a draw-down request to the bank.

Overdue.definition: An invoice still to pay after its due date.

Not started.definition: A task whose work has not begun.

In progress.definition: A task whose work has begun and is not done.

Done.definition: A task whose work is finished.

Planned.definition: A purchase that is not ordered yet.

Ordered.definition: A purchase that is ordered and has no delivery date yet.

Delivery scheduled.definition: A purchase that is ordered and has a delivery date.

Upcoming.definition: A milestone not reached yet and on time.

Reached.definition: A milestone that has been reached.

Eligible.definition: A grant you qualify for but have not applied for.

Applied.definition: A grant you have applied for.

Approved.definition: A grant the programme has approved.

Received.definition: A grant whose payout has arrived (the end marker; no amount is tracked).

Rejected.definition: A grant the programme has turned down.

Active.definition: A funding source you can still allocate costs to.

Used up.definition: A funding source with nothing left to allocate.

Closed.definition: A funding source you no longer use.

Open.definition: A defect that is not being fixed yet.

Fixed.definition: A defect that has been fixed.

On budget.definition: The verdict when Left to spend is zero or more.

Over budget.definition: The verdict when Left to spend is below zero.

Left to spend.definition: Funding total and expected grants minus expected cost, shown with its range.

Funding total.definition: The sum of all active funding sources.

Expected cost.definition: Everything signed or billed, plus open estimates and amounts not yet split.

Expected grants.definition: What the approved grants are expected to pay back, from their rates and caps.

Still to pay.definition: Invoices and progress payments that are due and not paid yet.

Not yet paid.definition: Expected cost minus what is paid: unpaid invoices plus offers and estimates not invoiced yet.

Ready to submit.definition: Paid or due amounts funded by a loan or credit line that no draw-down request includes yet.

Remaining on offer.definition: An offer's amount minus the progress payments made against it.

Not yet split.definition: The part of an offer or invoice not divided into cost lines yet.

Allocated.definition: The cost of the cost lines a funding source pays for.

Unallocated.definition: A funding source's amount minus what is allocated, when that is zero or more.

Over-allocated.definition: What is allocated beyond a funding source's amount.

Amount.definition: The record's own amount: an offer, invoice, progress payment or funding source.

Eligible costs up to.definition: A grant's cap on eligible costs, as in the grant letter.

Estimate.definition: The planned amount of a cost line that has no offer or invoice yet.

de.note: Decision recorded on #2190 (comment 6090378393); pending owner veto at the P0 checkpoint.

Range.definition: The best and the worst case around a money figure.

Needs attention.definition: Facts on Home that need a decision or an action from the household.

Tidy up.definition: Records on Home with missing or inconsistent details to complete.

This week.definition: What starts, ends or is due in the next days, with a link to the schedule.

Not now.definition: Hides a row on Home for 7 days.

Payment.definition: An invoice or progress payment was paid; as a tab, the payments of a record.

Submission.definition: Amounts were included in a draw-down request.

Overview.definition: The first tab of a detail page: its summary.

Timing.definition: The tab with dates, dependencies and milestones.

Work.definition: The tab with the tasks or purchases that belong to a record.

Cost.definition: The tab with cost lines, offers and invoices.

de.note: Inflects with the noun: Neue Aufgabe, Neuer Meilenstein, Neues Angebot. Decision recorded on #2190 (comment 6090378393); pending owner veto at the P0 checkpoint.

Add.definition: Add a sub-record: a cost line, progress payment, contact person or checklist item.

Remove.definition: Disconnect a linked record without deleting it.

Save.definition: The only commit verb, for every form.

Cancel.definition: Leave a form without saving; it always comes before Save.

de.note: Example: Heute erfassen. Decision recorded on #2190 (comment 6090378393); pending owner veto at the P0 checkpoint.

Log.definition: Create a diary entry, as in "Log today".

Mark.definition: Set a state directly: Mark done, Mark paid, Mark reached, Mark delivered, Mark ordered.

de.note: Decision recorded on #2190 (comment 6090378393); pending owner veto at the P0 checkpoint.

Split.definition: Divide an offer or invoice into cost lines.

More.definition: The phone and tablet sheet that holds every place not on the bottom bar and your personal settings.

Undo.definition: Reverse the last change while its undo window is still open.

Today.definition: The current date, offered as a one-tap choice when setting a date.

Discard.definition: Throw away unsaved changes or a draft.

Keep editing.definition: Close a discard prompt and return to the open form.

Pick a date.definition: Open a date control to choose when a status change happened.
